questions.question: In Six Days, Seven Nights, what strands Ford’s pilot and Anne Heche’s editor together?
questions.answer: A plane crash on a South Pacific island
choices: A plane crash on a South Pacific island
questions.note: Ford plays cargo pilot Quinn Harris, who crash-lands with magazine editor Robin Monroe.

questions.question: Which actor co-stars with Harrison Ford in Six Days, Seven Nights?
questions.note: Heche plays Robin Monroe, who is stranded with Ford’s pilot on a South Pacific island.

questions.question: What brings Ford and Kristin Scott Thomas’s characters together in Random Hearts?
questions.answer: Their spouses die together in a plane crash
choices: Their spouses die together in a plane crash
They work on the same political campaign
They are stranded on an island
questions.note: The crash exposes an affair between their spouses. Ford plays police sergeant Dutch Van Den Broeck.

questions.question: Which actor co-stars with Ford in Random Hearts?
questions.note: Scott Thomas plays Kay Chandler, who investigates the apparent affair behind the crash with Ford’s Dutch.

questions.question: What side job does Ford’s LAPD detective work in Hollywood Homicide?
questions.note: Detective Joe Gavilan keeps trying to sell houses while investigating a music-industry murder.

questions.question: Which actor plays Ford’s younger LAPD partner in Hollywood Homicide?
questions.note: Hartnett plays K.C. Calden in the 2003 buddy-cop film.

questions.question: In Firewall, how do criminals force Ford’s bank-security expert to help them?
choices: They threaten to expose an affair
questions.note: Paul Bettany’s gang seizes Jack Stanfield’s family and demands that he breach the bank.

questions.question: In What Lies Beneath, which actor plays Ford’s wife, Claire Spencer?
questions.note: Pfeiffer plays Claire, who suspects their lakeside home is haunted.

questions.question: In Crossing Over, Harrison Ford plays an officer for which U.S. agency?
questions.note: Ford plays ICE agent Max Brogan in the Los Angeles-set immigration drama.

questions.question: In Extraordinary Measures, Ford’s researcher pursues a treatment for which disease?
questions.note: Ford plays Dr. Robert Stonehill, who works with a father seeking treatment for his children.
